halsey-rows: The hand-planted pine forest at Halsey, Nebraska: dead-straight rows of ponderosa and jack pine on rolling sandhills, a sand two-track running between the rows, a small white ranger's cabin with its windows boarded neatly.
sandhills-windmill: The Nebraska Sandhills: endless grass-covered dunes under a huge sky, a lone steel windmill and stock tank in a hollow, a small blue lake reflecting the sky.
platte-cranes: The braided Platte River in central Nebraska at dusk: wide shallow channels and pale sandbars, thousands of sandhill cranes standing in the water, a line of cottonwoods.
courthouse: Interior of a small-town Nebraska county courthouse, Register of Deeds office: oak counters, tall windows, rows of bound deed books on steel shelves, dust in the light, a wall clock stopped.
mainstreet: Main street of a small Nebraska Sandhills town: brick storefronts kept carefully but empty, a grain elevator at the end of the street, grass growing through the pavement, a water tower.
